cases.name: 中际旭创

invariants: Use causal forward-adjusted prices through the cutoff.
Do not classify the 2024-06-06 raw ex-right discontinuity alone as a breakdown.

cases.rationale: Corporate-action robustness candidate. Geometry must be reviewed on the adjusted series before this case becomes scoreable.

cases.name: 盐湖股份

invariants: Do not synthesize daily bars inside the suspension interval.
Keep the first post-resumption bar dated 2021-08-10 and expose the discontinuity as uncertainty.

cases.rationale: Long-suspension robustness candidate. Human review must distinguish resumption repricing from a normal continuous-series breakout.

cases.name: 贵州茅台

invariants: Retain the genuine 2023-11-01 upward gap as price evidence rather than smoothing it away.
Do not promote the gap alone to a confirmed trend breakout without boundary and follow-through evidence.

cases.rationale: Genuine event-gap candidate with large volume. Human reviewers must label nearby levels and whether any breakout interpretation is acceptable.
